roads.name: Lake Tahoe North Shore Scenic Byway;Lake Tahoe - Eastshore Drive
words: Properly twisty: 35 curves in 6.9 miles, about 5 a mile.
From 6,250 to 6,883 ft, with 1,137 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
Water alongside for stretches.
10 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 79°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 45 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.26 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
